newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine deficit will go with growth - Cavallo.
newsitem.headline: Argentine deficit will go with growth - Cavallo.

text.p: Former Argentine Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo said the reduction and final elimination of the budget deficit will only happen with a return of economic growth.
Cavallo made his remarks in a seminar he gave at the Kansas City Federal Reserve.
Cavallo said the largest-ever amount of taxes collected for the month of July was testimony to the fact that a rebound in growth will narrow the budget deficit.

In the speech, published by daily La Nacion newspaper, Cavallo said the reappearance of a fiscal deficit at the end of 1994 came about because of automatic increases in social security spending, as well as reductions in distorting taxes such as payroll tax which was introduced to increase productivity and employment.
Cavallo said that the jobless rate, currently near historic highs, has its roots in the rigidities of the labor market and low productivity levels at the end of the 1980s.
Cavallo estimated the deficit this year will amount to two percent of gross domestic product.
